disclaimer: Reminder reference only — NOT legal authority. Season dates, zones, and limits are set annually and can change. Always verify current regulations with the Missouri Department of Conservation before hunting or trapping. In communities of 10,000 or more, only cage-type or foot-enclosing traps within 150 ft of residences.

license_summary.general: Missouri residents need a Small Game Hunting Permit to hunt furbearers and a Resident Trapping Permit ($11.00, residents only) to trap furbearers and sell pelts; the trapping permit also allows trapping groundhogs and rabbits (rabbit carcasses may not be sold). Nonresidents need the Nonresident Furbearer Hunting and Trapping Permit ($221.50). Trapping on conservation areas requires a special-use permit applied for at least 30 days before trapping begins. Traps may be placed/set for furbearers at 12:01 a.m. on Nov. 15 and must be removed by midnight of the last day of the trapping season.

permit_requirements: Bobcats and otters or their pelts must be delivered to an agent of the Conservation Department for registration or tagging before selling, transferring, tanning, or mounting, BY APRIL 10. Tagged bobcats, otters, or their pelts may be possessed by the taker throughout the year and sold only to licensed taxidermists, tanners, or fur dealers. It is illegal to purchase or sell untagged bobcats, otters, or their pelts.

species.notes: Coyotes, except as otherwise provided, may be taken by hunting and pelts/carcasses possessed, transported, and sold in any numbers throughout the year. Coyotes may NOT be taken during daylight hours from April 1 through the day prior to the beginning of spring turkey season. From Jan 1-Sept 30 (excluding the spring turkey season), artificial light, night vision, infrared, and thermal imagery equipment may be used to take coyotes; during the spring turkey season, coyotes may be taken only during legal turkey shooting hours with methods allowed for spring turkey (hunters must have an unfilled spring turkey permit plus a small game or furbearer permit).

verification.confirmation_notes: Data taken from official MDC 2026-27 seasons pages (downloaded/opened 2026-09-18): seasons-by-species page, seasons-at-a-glance table, trapping page, and trapping regulations page. 3 CSR 10-8.515 (official text on mdc.mo.gov, amended May 16, 2025) confirms all listed furbearers are taken 'in any numbers by trapping only' with the statewide dates and the Mar 1-Apr 14 private-land special harvest season (coyote, opossum, raccoon, striped skunk). Bobcat/otter registration-by-April-10 rule from the official trapping regulations page. Coyote hunting: Jan 1-Dec 31, 2026 with the daylight-hours turkey-season restriction and method rules. Early Aug 1-Oct 15 season (raccoon, opossum, striped skunk) and its foot-enclosing/cage-trap-only restriction confirmed. Coyote trapping: Nov 15, 2026-Feb 28, 2027 plus the private-land extension. Closed furbearers (mountain lion, spotted skunk, long-tailed weasel) from the MDC 2025 regulations summary note.

General furbearer HUNTING hours were not stated on the 2026-27 MDC season pages reviewed; hunting seasons were modeled without open/close times. Verify in the full 2026 Missouri Hunting and Trapping Regulations summary (not yet published as of 2026-09-18).

Groundhog (woodchuck): the resident trapping permit notes allow trapping groundhogs, but no groundhog season dates appeared on the MDC season pages reviewed — no season was modeled. Verify whether Missouri has a groundhog season or whether it is incidental to furbearer trapping.
The by-species page row for 'Mink' etc. appeared under trapping only; mink/muskrat/beaver/nutria/otter have no hunting season in the sources reviewed.

Coyote hunting hours restriction 'may not be taken during daylight hours from April 1 through the day prior to spring turkey season' is as stated on MDC's coyote season row; night-take methods (artificial light/night vision/thermal Jan 1-Sept 30) still apply subject to the turkey-season rules.
Season close dates in 2027 (e.g., beaver through Mar 31, private-land extension through Apr 14) are as published for the 2026-27 season.
